title: Vampirism Wing Textures
description: Assigns vampire wing textures to players. Loaded by WingsManager/WingsSetting (IWingsEntity.Texture enum + player UUID list). The same player id may legitimately appear under multiple texture blocks; each occurrence grants that texture in addition to the others.

texture.description: Wing texture variant, matched against the IWingsEntity.Texture enum (serialized as lowercase enum name). A value outside this set fails to parse and the whole entry is dropped with a warning.

players.description: Players granted this wing texture. May be empty.

name.description: Human-readable label only; not read anywhere else in the code, not used for matching.

id.description: Minecraft account UUID. This is the only field used to match a player at runtime.
